title: Asset provenance record
description: One record per final asset, named <id>.json (docs/art-spec.md, Provenance record). npm run lint:assets enforces it.

id.description: Asset id, e.g. zurich-bg or zurich-obj-door@open

output.description: Repo-relative path of the shipped file

task.description: Task id from the execution map

candidate.description: Codex only: the chosen candidate number, e.g. 03

references.description: Codex only: reference images passed with the prompt

derivedFrom.description: Opus only: the asset id this was drawn from, if any

density.description: Density: 1 for the 320x160 art, 2 for 640x320 art (the Phase R pixel-art remaster, or Phase H painted art with style painted), 4 for the smooth HD path (1280x640 scenes, the cut-out rig; no palette, soft alpha). Absent means 1

style.description: Density 2 only. pixel (the default when absent): Phase R pixel art on the master palette, 64x128 character cells. painted: Phase H at MI3 pixel density, painted full colour with no master palette, at most 256 colours per scene folder with no dither, hard alpha, even sprite sides, and the cut-out rig at density 2
